Requisition Entry Prep

From the ORA eTraining module "Purchasing with Purpose: Procurement on Sponsored Projects" (lesson 4 of 15).
Requisitions: Procurements ≥ $5,000
At MSU, purchases above the $5,000 micro-purchase limit require a requisition to be entered through Banner before the procurement process can move forward. Before submitting a requisition, users should confirm that Banner access has been granted, sufficient funds are available in the appropriate budget, and the vendor is properly established in the MSU Procurement database.
Complete the content above before moving on.
Requisition Entry Checklist
appropriate access granted?
To enter a requisition in Banner a user must have Workflow access granted for the index/project that will incur the cost. For grants, PIs should submit Workflow requests for other project employees as needed. The PI's Workflow request should be submitted by their supervisor (Chair or Dean) or their departmental budget officer. Instructions on how to submit a Workflow request can be found in ORA's Navigating Banner: Essentials for Research Administration e-module on the ORA site .
funds in the correct budget pool?
During requisition entry, an initiator will need to select an account code (list attached below) that corresponds to the goods/services to be procured. Each account code impacts a different 'pool level' of your project budget. The individual who enters the requisition must review the project budget to ensure there are sufficient funds in the correct pool level. If you are not sure which account to select feel free to contact your departmental budget officer or ask.ora@morgan.edu .
Vendor in the Procurement System?
Prior to requisition entry a vendor must be setup in our procurement database. Please review the How To: Banner Requisition Entry lesson of this module for steps on how to query a vendor's Banner ID in Finance Self-Service. If the vendor has not done business with Morgan before then a Vendor Registration Form (attached below) must be completed and emailed to services.procurement@morgan.edu . Procurement will then provide a Vendor ID # in a response email. Requisitions for non-travel reimbursements and working funds would utilize the employee's MSU ID as the Vendor ID.
Statement of work (SOW) drafted?
Any procurement involving contractual services will require a clear Statement of Work (SOW) before the service agreement can be developed. The SOW should describe the services to be performed, expected deliverables, project timeline, performance expectations, and any special terms or requirements related to the work. This information is critical to draft the required MSU Service Contract (attached below).

Additional Considerations
Vendors (to include MSU employees and students) that owe state taxes will have their income withheld to satisfy their outstanding tax liability. It is not required for a requisition initiator to review this before hand, but this does occur infrequently and may be worth discussing with the vendor. Morgan, as an agency and instrumentality of the State of Maryland, has procurement regulations related to the preferred use of minority-owned business, small business certified entities, etc. A list of vendors with preferred qualifications can be obtained from the Procurement departments based on the type of desired goods/services. Procurement of furniture must be done through Maryland Correctional Enterprises (MCE). Information on their product line can be found with the Procurement department.

Vendors (to include MSU employees and students) that owe state taxes will have their payment(s) garnished to satisfy their outstanding tax liability.
Outstanding Vendor Tax Liability
Morgan, as an agency and instrumentality of the State of Maryland, follows procurement regulations related to the preferred use of minority-owned business, small business certified entities, etc. A list of vendors with preferred qualifications can be obtained from the Procurement department.
Utilizing Preferred Vendors
Procurement of furniture must be done through Maryland Correctional Enterprises (MCE), Maryland Works Inc., or Blind Industries and Services of Maryland . Information on their product availability can be found with the Procurement department.
Furniture Procurement
A specific item/service may only be available from a single vendor. In this case, complete the sole source determination form (attached below) and submit it as supporting documentation provided to Procurement and ORA. Sole source procurements 100k-500k require Presidential approval.
Sole Source Determination
A requisition initiator must email the following documents to Procurement and ORA: (1) MSU Vendor Contract (attached below), (2) Quotes (# varies based on total cost). Include the requisition # in your email's subject line.
